title: Work IQ: agents create and edit Office documents
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates data access by saying generated content can draw on anything the user can read, although Work IQ also enforces narrower policies and workload selections. Its mixed licensing classification also conflicts with its statement that licensing for this feature has not been published. The roadmap dates and both documented control paths are otherwise supported.
